Dense fitted sections — BLAZING soft peach-orange branching coral relief across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID iridescent pearl-white nacre sections shimmering pink and mint between the coral, with carved relief of waves across the surface of every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Her legs are pressed together and wound around from her ankles to above her knees with several turns of a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, locked at the front with a heavy iron padlock. Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber, a long built-in bench of rough-cut stone blocks running along the dungeon wall, a rough stone block wall behind it with iron rings bolted into it, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the stone walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM, solid material from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
